name: Sundowner on the plains
led_by: Your guide and the camp team
when: Late afternoon, as the light turns gold
live: The vehicle pulls up beside a table already laid in the grass. A cork is drawn, the plains turn amber and the first glass arrives as the sun drops toward the horizon.
good_to_know: Joins the end of an afternoon game drive.
alt: A guide pouring sparkling wine at a sundowner table on the plains
